questions.prompt: Which of these is a form of mass media?
questions.explanation: Newspapers distribute information to a large, dispersed audience.

questions.prompt: The receiver of a communication message is also called the:
questions.explanation: The audience is the person or group that receives the message.

questions.prompt: Which communication model includes feedback as a central element?
questions.explanation: The interactive model treats communication as a two-way process that includes feedback.
